name: Receipt compliance evidence path
source_description: Curated seed for receipt, evidence export, and compliance certificate work.

body.summary: Release qualification and compliance certificate work should prioritize protocol docs, compliance certificate spec, evidence export code, receipt store reports, kernel certificate tests, and conformance evidence before product release surfaces.
constraints: Do not rank Mercury product release code above protocol qualification evidence for compliance certificate queries.
Release claims must stay behind current qualification evidence.
Compliance certificate work should surface signed receipts and Merkle checkpoint context.
